fact: SENUM SA (Senegal) and SMTD-SA (Mali) inaugurated the interconnection of their national fibre-optic backbones at the Kidira-Diboli border bridge on Monday 2026-10-05, described by a speaker as the putting into service of the infrastructure; no capacity or traffic figure is given.
In June 2024 Mali's SMTD and Guinea's SOGEB agreed to interconnect the two countries' fibre networks.
The ROA-BN chairman, who heads Mali's Societe malienne de transmission, said the network is operational and Mali is connected to Cote d'Ivoire, Guinea and Senegal.
